entries.head: hand back

senses.en: to return work to students

example.en: She handed back the essays at the end of class.
example.zh: 下课的时候她把作文发回来了。

entries.l1_note: 发回是 hand back；交上去是 hand in。

entries.head: read through

senses.en: to read something from start to finish

example.en: Read through the questions before you start writing.
example.zh: 动笔前把题目通读一遍。

entries.l1_note: 通读是 read through；read up on 是查资料。

entries.head: copy down

senses.en: to write down what is written somewhere

example.en: Copy down the formula before she erases it.
example.zh: 趁她没擦把公式抄下来。

entries.l1_note: 抄下是 copy down；copy out 是誊写。

entries.head: copy out

senses.en: to write out a full copy

example.en: Copy out the paragraph by hand.
example.zh: 把这段手抄一遍。

entries.l1_note: 誊写是 copy out；抄袭是 copy（不文明）。

entries.head: hand out

senses.en: to give something to each person

example.en: Can you hand out the worksheets?
example.zh: 你能把练习纸发一下吗？

entries.l1_note: 分发是 hand out；hand in 是交上来。

entries.head: plow through

senses.en: to finish something long or difficult

example.en: I plowed through three chapters last night.
example.zh: 我昨晚硬啃了三章。

entries.l1_note: 硬啃是 plow through；美式拼 plow，英式 plough。

entries.head: wade through

senses.en: to get through something long and boring

example.en: We waded through forty pages of regulations.
example.zh: 我们啃了四十页规定。

entries.l1_note: 艰难过一遍是 wade through，画面是蹚水。

entries.head: muddle through

senses.en: to manage without a clear plan

example.en: I muddled through the presentation with no slides.
example.zh: 我一张幻灯片没有，硬着头皮讲完了。

entries.l1_note: 勉强应付是 muddle through；muddle up 是弄乱。

entries.head: stumble through

senses.en: to do something with many mistakes

example.en: He stumbled through the reading in class.
example.zh: 他在课上磕磕绊绊地念完了。

entries.l1_note: 磕绊完成是 stumble through；stumble on 是偶然发现。

entries.head: think through

senses.en: to consider all parts of an idea

example.en: Think through your argument before the debate.
example.zh: 辩论前把你的论点想清楚。

entries.l1_note: 想清楚是 think through；think over 是反复权衡。

entries.head: puzzle out

senses.en: to solve something by thinking hard

example.en: I finally puzzled out how the formula works.
example.zh: 我终于琢磨出这个公式怎么用了。

entries.l1_note: 琢磨出是 puzzle out；puzzle 是谜题。

entries.head: flip through

senses.en: to look through pages quickly

example.en: I flipped through the magazine at the dentist.
example.zh: 在牙医那儿我翻了翻杂志。

entries.l1_note: 快速翻是 flip through；flip back 是往回翻。

entries.head: leaf through

senses.en: to turn pages casually

example.en: She leafed through the textbook waiting for class.
example.zh: 等上课的时候她翻了翻课本。

entries.l1_note: 翻阅是 leaf through；leaf 是书页。

entries.head: skim through

senses.en: to read quickly for the main points

example.en: Skim through the chapter before the lecture.
example.zh: 上课前把这章略读一遍。

entries.l1_note: 略读是 skim through；scan through 是找关键词。

entries.head: scan through

senses.en: to look quickly for specific information

example.en: Scan through the text for dates.
example.zh: 在文章里扫一下日期。

entries.l1_note: 扫读找信息是 scan through；scan in 是扫描录入。

entries.head: pore over

senses.en: to study something very carefully

example.en: He pored over the contract for an hour.
example.zh: 他对着合同研究了一小时。

entries.l1_note: 研读是 pore over；pour over 是倒上去，别写错。

entries.head: stay up

senses.en: to not go to bed

example.en: I stayed up till two finishing the essay.
example.zh: 我熬到两点把论文写完。

entries.l1_note: 熬夜是 stay up；stay in 是待在家。

entries.head: go back over

senses.en: to check something again

example.en: Go back over your answers before you submit.
example.zh: 交卷前把答案回看一遍。

entries.l1_note: 回看是 go back over；go over 是过一遍。

entries.head: read over

senses.en: to read something to check it

example.en: Read over your essay once more.
example.zh: 作文再通读一遍。

entries.l1_note: 通读检查是 read over；read out 是念出来。

entries.head: scribble down

senses.en: to write something quickly and untidily

example.en: I scribbled down the page number.
example.zh: 我潦草记下了页码。

entries.l1_note: 潦草记是 scribble down；scribble 是乱涂。

entries.head: stay behind

senses.en: to remain after others leave

example.en: A few students stayed behind to ask questions.
example.zh: 几个学生留下来问问题。

entries.l1_note: 留下是 stay behind；落在后面是 fall behind。

entries.head: stay back

senses.en: to remain after school as punishment

example.en: He stayed back to finish the test.
example.zh: 他留下来把考试补完。

entries.l1_note: 留堂是 stay back；也指站远一点。

entries.head: cross out

senses.en: to draw a line through something

example.en: Cross out the wrong answer and write the new one.
example.zh: 把错的划掉写新的。

entries.l1_note: 划掉是 cross out；cross off 是勾掉。

entries.head: cross off

senses.en: to mark an item as done

example.en: Cross off each topic once you review it.
example.zh: 复习完一个就划掉一个。

entries.l1_note: 勾掉是 cross off；划错是 cross out。

entries.head: read off

senses.en: to read items from a list

example.en: He read off the names one by one.
example.zh: 他把名字一个个念出来。

entries.l1_note: 照着念是 read off；read out 是大声读。

entries.head: think up

senses.en: to invent an idea or excuse

example.en: He thought up a better example on the spot.
example.zh: 他当场想出一个更好的例子。

entries.l1_note: 想出是 think up；think over 是考虑。

entries.head: dream up

senses.zh: 编出一个不现实的东西
senses.en: to invent something unrealistic

example.en: Who dreamed up this schedule?
example.zh: 这日程是谁想出来的？

entries.l1_note: 凭空想出是 dream up，常带吐槽。

entries.head: latch onto

senses.en: to take hold of an idea or person

example.en: The teacher latched onto my example and used it all class.
example.zh: 老师抓住我的例子讲了一整节课。

entries.l1_note: 抓住不放是 latch onto；latch 是门闩。

entries.head: look through

senses.en: to search through a group of things

example.en: Look through your notes for the definition.
example.zh: 在笔记里翻一下定义。

entries.l1_note: 翻查是 look through；look into 是调查。

entries.head: flip back

senses.en: to turn pages back

example.en: Flip back to page twelve.
example.zh: 翻回第十二页。

entries.l1_note: 往回翻是 flip back；flip through 是快速翻。
